en-GB.title: The Loyalty Loop for Business
en-GB.subtitle: Loyalty rewards for your shop
en-GB.description:
The Loyalty Loop for Business is the easiest way to run a loyalty programme for your cafe, salon, bakery or shop - no card printer, no extra hardware.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Stamp customers in seconds: scan their code or type it in
- Set your own reward: stamps, points, or visit-based
- See what's working: visits, repeat-visit rate, rewards and reviews in one view
- Personalised AI coach: weekly wins, watch-outs and next steps based on your data
- Deep AI Business Report: summarise your reviews, spot red flags, and get growth ideas
- Get discovered: your shop appears on the map in the customer app

Setup takes minutes - add your address, pin your location on the map, write a short description, and you're live to nearby shoppers.

Free to get started.
en-GB.releaseNotes: The first release of The Loyalty Loop for Business. Set up a digital loyalty programme, stamp customers with a scan, and track what drives repeat visits.
en-GB.promoText: Run a digital loyalty programme in minutes. Stamp customers with a scan, see what drives repeat visits, and get weekly AI coaching.
